hints.title: Immediate Execution with Periodic Interval Scheduling
hints.text: The function invokes immediately at time zero and subsequently every t milliseconds until cancelled.

hints.title: Interval Handle Storage and Closure
hints.text: Trigger fn(...args) synchronously. Start setInterval with period t. Return a cancellation function calling clearInterval.

hints.title: Interval Blueprint
hints.text: fn(...args); const timer = setInterval(() => fn(...args), t); return () => clearInterval(timer);

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Initial call and interval setup execute in constant time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Starting setInterval without invoking fn immediately delays the first execution by t milliseconds.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Retains single numeric timer identifier in closure.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Ensuring zero-delay initial execution before interval cadence begins.

solutions.approach: Immediate Execution with Periodic Interval Timer
